items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: I heard Sidney Bechet’s version of “The Onions,” “Les Onignons.” ... I’d read Bechet’s autobiography.

ctx.x: How did you fall in love with the music?

Oh I can tell you quite specifically. I wrote a series not long ago called “The First Time,” where I asked people about the kind of Damascene moment. And it was quite interesting, you know the different reactions. I know precisely when mine was. I was fifteen years of age. I was in France staying with some cousins, and I went down to a students’ café, and on the juke box they were playing music I’d not heard before.
